failure_policy: Keep initial draft/static correction, all frozen bytes, actual first stdout/stderr/exit/UTC/counts and partial raw result on any exception. No scientific execution before ownerGO. No hidden rerun, silent fallback, clipping or tolerance relaxation.
claim_ceiling: Local conditional exact-root theorem is separate from stored-point numerical approximation.
No interval coefficient/root/J enclosure, original physical uncertainty or native equivalence.
No quantitative Taylor remainder, convergence-rate certificate, certified positive width of validity, or arbitrary positive-width nesting/monotonicity.
One stored width diagnostic is not a new root or validation campaign.
